hero.body: AllOne Garden is a multiplayer gardening game you can self-host on any device - Raspberry Pi, Mac, Windows PC, Linux server, or Android phone. No central server. No subscriptions. Just community, plants, and good soil.

features.subtitle: Designed from the ground up for community servers - private, fast, and fully under your control.

decentralized.title: Decentralized by design
decentralized.body: Every server is independent. Connect with other gardens through P2P federation.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: Your data lives on your own hardware without cloud lock-in.

plugins.title: Plugin system
plugins.body: Extend the game with community plugins - sandboxed and safe.

mobile.title: Mobile ready
mobile.body: Play on iOS and Android as a Progressive Web App.

seasons.title: Real seasons
seasons.body: Weather changes daily and affects strategy and growth.

multiplayer.title: True multiplayer
multiplayer.body: Visit neighbours, trade crops, and help with daily tasks.

preview.subtitle: A clean web UI that feels at home in the browser, on mobile, or on a community kiosk screen.
preview.window_title: AllOne Garden - Alice's Server · 12 players online
preview.garden_area: Garden area with plots and tools

federation.subtitle: AllOne Garden servers discover each other over the network without a central registry.

chat.title: Cross-server chat
chat.body: Federated chat messages can be shown with source context.

visits.title: Garden visits
visits.body: Visit gardens on other servers and help with crops.

optin.title: Opt-in only
optin.body: Federation remains optional and under server-owner control.

step1.title: 1. Pick your server device
step1.body: Pi, spare laptop, Mac, Windows PC, or Android phone.

step2.title: 2. Run the installer
step2.body: One script setup for Node and related dependencies.

step3.title: 3. Invite your friends
step3.body: Share your URL and start planting together quickly.

step4.title: 4. Extend with plugins
step4.body: Community plugins can be added and managed safely.

setup.label: Setup & Mobile
setup.title: Install once, play everywhere
setup.subtitle: Start your server on any platform, then join instantly from desktop or phone.

pi.title: Raspberry Pi / Linux
pi.body: Production-ready setup with HTTPS and reverse proxy support.

android.title: Android (Termux)
android.body: Run a full local multiplayer setup from your phone.

docker.title: Docker
docker.body: Quickest cross-platform route for local or hosted setups.

ios.title: iOS - Safari (PWA)
ios.body: Open in Safari, use Share, and choose Add to Home Screen.

android.title: Android - Chrome (PWA)
android.body: Use Add to Home screen or Install app from the browser menu.

benefits.title: What you get
benefits.body: Single setup flow, full-screen mobile UX, quick launch, and auto updates.

community.label: Community & Creators
community.title: Tools outside the in-game HUD
community.subtitle: Gardendex and plugin tools live on the homepage, not in the in-game header.
community.plugins_body: Build the online world together: create tools, plants, and features with drag-and-drop flows.
community.gradendex_body: Contribute your plant knowledge and help expand the Gardendex.
community.docs_body: Program along with clear guides to build plugins, extend gameplay, and contribute code.

cta.title: Ready to start growing?
cta.body: Your server, your rules, your community. No subscriptions, no central authority.

security.title: Security hardened
security.body: Rate limits, headers, and secure defaults.
